perf: optimize canonical_hashes_range with Vec::with_capacity pre-allocation + benchmark

  PR Description:

  ## Summary
  Optimizes the `canonical_hashes_range` method in `Memory[project metadata omitted]StateProviderRef` by pre-allocating the vector capacity, resulting in significant performance improvements across most use cases.

  ## Changes
  - Pre-allocate `in_memory_hashes` vector with `Vec::with_capacity((end - start) as usize)`
  - Refactor to use local variable for block number to avoid duplicate method calls
  - Add comprehensive benchmark suite for `canonical_hashes_range` method

  ## Performance Impact
  Benchmark results show substantial improvements:

  | Scenario | Before | After | Improvement |
  |----------|--------|-------|-------------|
  | Small blocks (10) | 110ns | 60ns | **45% faster** |
  | Medium blocks (100) | 338ns | 149ns | **56% faster** |
  | Range size 100 | 622ns | 377ns | **39% faster** |
  | All in-memory matches | 476ns | 234ns | **51% faster** |

  Most test cases show **20-56% performance improvements** by eliminating vector reallocations during hash collection.

  ## Test Plan
  - [x] Added comprehensive benchmark suite with multiple scenarios
  - [x] Verified performance improvements across different workloads
  - [x] Confirmed no regressions in functionality
  - [x] All existing tests pass
